messages:
Ava (AE): FYI — CheroHealth wants a 2yr commitment, $180k ARR (billed quarterly 4x $45k), net30, and a prorated clawback if they terminate in year 1. POC is running and they'd like PO submitted today. Quote: https://redwood/quote/CH-4321 :eyes:
Devon (Deal Desk): Can you share why quarterly invoicing vs our standard annual upfront? need the business rationale and risk mitigations for billing/collections.
Ava (AE): They're a mid-market health-tech customer, constrained procurement. CFO insists on quarterly for cashflow. We win by pricing at commit-level (we already discounted 15% off list), plus they want 30d net not 60. Sales math keeps ARR but spreads cash.
Priya (Sales Ops): Quick checklist: billing entity confirmed? PO name? vendor tax forms? Also we need explicit invoice schedule in contract. If we split invoice, ops needs exact dates to create recurring invoices.
Luca (SE): POC acceptance timeline: finish validation by 4/10, integration work done by 4/20. I'd prefer first invoice to align with go-live acceptance (to avoid refund churn). Suggest first invoice 30 days after acceptance date.
Devon (Deal Desk): Ok — two asks: 1) proposed clawback language (how is proration calculated, does usage get deducted?), 2) credit profile. If credit risk is medium, we may require first invoice wire or ACH.
Ava (AE): Clawback suggested by customer: refund pro rata on remaining committed value, minus any usage overage. Example: cancel after 9 months -> refund 12 months left / 24? their wording a bit fuzzy. Credit profile: they are private, some NHS integrations, CFO says good standing but no credit references yet.
Nina (Legal): Draft suggestion — "If Customer terminates for convenience within the first 12 months, Redwood will refund the unused portion of prepaid fees calculated on a pro rata daily basis, less any unpaid usage-based charges and a processing fee equal to 5% of the refunded amount." Also: limit clawback to termination for convenience only; no refund for termination for breach.
Priya (Sales Ops): Ops note: if we do quarterly invoices but allow a refund later, accounting impact is messy. We need a clawback ledger treatment — finance must sign off. Also require PO to reference invoice milestones, sample memo: 
````
Invoice 1 (Q1): covers service start date - day 90, amount $45,000
Invoice 2 (Q2): day 91 - day 180, amount $45,000
Invoice 3 (Q3): day 181 - day 270, amount $45,000
Invoice 4 (Q4): day 271 - day 360, amount $45,000
````
Devon (Deal Desk): FinanceBot — can you run the quick credit/collections rule? If credit < B we require first invoice wire; if >= B, net30 ok. Also confirm whether 5% processing fee acceptable.
FinanceBot: Auto-check complete — no public credit score found. Internal guideline: unknown private org => treat as medium risk. Recommend: first invoice wire or ACH, require PO, and finance approval for clawback. 5% processing fee is allowable.
Devon (Deal Desk): Decision: approve quarterly invoicing and clawback in principle with these conditions — (1) PO and signed SOW, (2) first invoice to be wire/ACH if finance flags medium risk, (3) clawback limited to termination for convenience within first 12 months, pro rata daily refund less unpaid usage and 5% processing fee, (4) legal to insert language Nina proposed, (5) Sales Ops to provide explicit invoice schedule.
Ava (AE): Thanks — I'll update customer and attach PO language. Will ask CFO if they can do ACH for first payment. I'll also add the acceptance-aligned invoice start date per Luca.
Luca (SE): I'll timestamp acceptance in Jira (TICKET-987) and ping ops when it's closed so ops can issue invoice.
Nina (Legal): I'll add the clause to the SOW and mark legal-approved with the limitation Devon noted.
Priya (Sales Ops): Once PO arrives, tag me and I'll create the 4 recurring invoices with the dates above.
Ava (AE): Great — keeping customer informed. If finance insists on upfront for risk, will ask for a one-quarter deposit.
Devon (Deal Desk): Marking this thread approved-with-conditions. Please follow the checklist before invoicing. :white_check_mark:
Ava (AE): Will do, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
